div.head: Quadr II 8b
div.ab: Specialem tamen Girardus archiepiscopus et tantam in oculis omnium Romanorum gratiam meruit, ut nulla blasphemantium uel contradicentium studia super eum deinceps Romæ processerint, licet de eo fama publicauerit, quod, exulante Cantuariorum archiepiscopo Anselmo, in eius diocesi quosdam intronizatos consecrare uoluisset.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 545 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)

note.seg: Paschal II. bannte 12. Dec. 1102 die Gesandten, weil sie seine mündliche Investiturerlaubniss nur erlogen hätten
Paschal II excommunicated the envoys on 12 Dec. 1102 because they had merely invented his oral permission for investiture
Gerhard beabsichtigte solchen Eingriff schon Ende 1102 vor Anselms Abreise. Er leugnet unten II 10 die Absicht nur für 1105
Gerard intended such an encroachment as early as the end of 1102, before Anselm’s departure. Below, II 10, he denies the intention only for 1105
